question: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018?
sql:
WITH annual_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS annual_delivered_orders
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
        AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_year AS (
    SELECT year
    FROM annual_counts
    ORDER BY annual_delivered_orders ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS monthly_delivered_orders
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_delivered_customer_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
        AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT MAX(mc.monthly_delivered_orders) AS highest_monthly_delivered_orders
FROM monthly_counts mc
JOIN lowest_year ly ON mc.year = ly.year
